name: Nesrine
description: Nesrine's performance at MONOM, Berlin's spatial audio research center, places the Franco-Tunisian singer-songwriter in one of the city's most experimental sonic environments. Known for blending North African melodies with electronic production and R&B sensibility, Nesrine represents a new generation of diasporic artists rewriting the rules of genre and identity. Performing at MONOM—a space designed for immersive, 4D sound—suggests a show that treats voice and production as architecture, exploring how migration, memory, and modernity sound in three dimensions.
